content.title: Cape Coral Criminal Defense Attorney | Lee Viacava Law Firm
content.text: The Experienced Criminal Defense You Need In Cape CoralLast updated on December 8, 2025 If you have been accused of a crime or were arrested in Cape Coral, you can trust the Lee Viacava Law Firm to handle your case with due care. Our criminal defense lawyer has been a strong advocate for the accused in Lee County for more than 18 years. We understand criminal charges can have immediate and long-term consequences. Whether you are facing a misdemeanor or felony charges, you need your lawyer to be proactive. Attorney Lee Viacava takes an aggressive approach when speaking with the State Attorney, challenging witness statements, police reports and other evidence to put you in position for a dismissal or other favorable result. Protecting Your Rights And Your Future Lee Viacava has represented countless Cape Coral residents and gets many of his referrals from those satisfied clients. In over 18 years of focused experience in criminal law, cases have included but are not limited to: Armed robbery Assault and battery Boating under the influence (BUI) Burglary Criminal mischief Dealing in stolen property Domestic Relations Domestic Violence (DV) Driving under the influence (DUI) Drug possession or trafficking DWLS (driving while license suspended) Firearm offenses Fraud and embezzlement Internet crimes Murder or manslaughter No valid driver’s license Possession of controlled substance Sexual battery Theft crimes Violation of probation Welfare fraud Things happen fast in criminal proceedings. Don’t try to talk your way out of trouble, let Mr. Viacava do the talking for you. You can’t take a wait-and-see approach. If you have been arrested or questioned by Cape Coral police in connection with a crime, your best move is to exercise your rights to remain silent and immediately call the Lee Viacava Law Firm. What do clients say about working with Lee Viacava? Experience Matters In Criminal Defense Lee Viacava has practiced criminal defense for more than 18 years, and he has developed a reputation as a skilled and tenacious trial lawyer. He has received many professional accolades, including recognition by The National Trial Lawyers as one of the Top 100 criminal defense attorneys in Florida. Lee grew up in southwest Florida and has strong ties in the community. He returned to Lee County after law school and has practiced here ever since. Mr. Viacava is equipped for high-stakes and high-profile felony cases with long prison terms on the line. He also defends people charged with any and all misdemeanors. No matter what the charges, he gives every case the full attention it deserves. Arrested While Visiting Cape Coral? The Lee Viacava Law Firm regularly represents out-of-towners who have been charged with driving under the influence, drug offenses or other crimes while visiting or passing through Cape Coral or staying on Pine Island or Sanibel Island. If your vacation in the Waterfront Wonderland was disrupted by an arrest or a summons to court, you will want Lee Viacava, a local defense lawyer, as a buffer against the worst penalties. Lee Viacava knows how to navigate the Lee County court system and fight the charges on your behalf. One-On-One Attention After A Cape Coral Arrest Lee Viacava is personally involved in every facet of your case. He will meet with you and accompany you to all court appearances if he is not able to get your appearance waived. He works every angle of your case, from filing motions to exploring negotiations with the prosecutor. At every stage of your case, he is accessible and responsive. Our law office is located just a few blocks from the Lee County Courthouse. To arrange a free consultation with a veteran Cape Coral criminal defense lawyer, call 239-672-8934 or contact us by email.
